params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:

All occurrences of these literals in the test methods are replaced with the corresponding constants, which improves maintainability and reduces the risk of errors during refactoring. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; the rest of the code remains intact except for the addition of the constants and their usage. The added newline at the end is harmless and common in code formatting.
